perm.downloads.why: To find installers, app builds and archives you no longer need. Files from Downloads always go to the Trash.
perm.folder.why: Some of your project folders are inside {{.Folder}}, which macOS protects. Without access, those projects can't be scanned.
perm.admin: Allow actions that need the administrator password
perm.admin.why: macOS asks for the password each time, and only to remove simulator caches in /Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Caches. When this is off, those items are skipped.
perm.note: macOS doesn't let apps change their own permissions. These switches decide what Disk Cleaner uses; to take a permission away completely, use System Settings.
intro.title: Before the first scan
intro.text: Disk Cleaner uses these permissions. You can change them any time in Settings › Permissions.
intro.downloads_note: macOS will ask you to allow access to Downloads right after you continue.
